Here are the average body masses by species:

| Species | Average Body Mass (g) |
|---------|----------------------|

Gentoo penguins are noticeably heavier on average, weighing about 1,300-1,400 grams more than both Adelie and Chinstrap penguins, which have similar average body masses.
